description: Implementation of PricingService interface for calculating product prices, formatting amounts, and related utilities in a sales management system.

classes.name: PricingServiceImpl
classes.description: Service class providing methods to calculate product prices and format monetary amounts, with dependencies injected for utility functions.

methods.name: calculateProductPrice
methods.description: Calculates final price for a product, with optional customer or attributes, delegating to ProductPriceUtils.

methods.name: getDisplayAmount
methods.description: Formats a BigDecimal amount into a localized string with currency for display in store context.

methods.name: getDisplayAmount
methods.description: Overloaded; formats a BigDecimal amount into a localized string with currency, considering locale and currency.

methods.name: getStringAmount
methods.description: Formats amount into an admin-facing formatted string.
